# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the story  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband (used humorously for his meekness)  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He had long iron-gray hair that touched his shoulders and had worn a full, soft brown beard since he was twenty years old. He looked almost as gray at sixty as he did in his youth, though his hair grayer. In his final year, he grew noticeably grayer and was seen with a drawn, gray face during his fatal heart spell.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001)_

## Personality

Matthew was exceptionally shy, quiet, and silent, hating to go among strangers or to talk in public. He dreaded all women except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde, holding a quiet fear that women secretly laughed at him. Despite his extreme shyness, he possessed a gentle, sympathetic heart and a quiet persistency, often sticking silently to his inclinations. He loved talkative people who required no conversation from him, forming a deep, silent friendship with Anne Shirley from the moment he met her.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet, introverted life at Green Gables alongside his sister Marilla. Due to advancing age and heart trouble, he and Marilla decided to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work. When Matthew drove to Bright River station, he discovered that a little girl named Anne Shirley had been sent by mistake instead. Reluctant to leave her at the station, he brought her home, falling under her charming personality along the drive and silently desiring to keep her. Matthew continually advocated for keeping Anne and indulged her far more than Marilla did, secretly buying her a puff-sleeved dress for Christmas with the assistance of Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Throughout her schooling, Matthew took immense pride in Anne's academic success and ambitions. Over time, his heart condition worsened while he continued to work hard on the farm. Upon reading a newspaper report announcing the sudden collapse of the Abbey Bank where all his savings were kept, Matthew suffered a fatal heart attack on the threshold of Green Gables and was buried in Avonlea.

## Background by volume

- Son of the man who original founded the Green Gables homestead  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Lived all his life at Green Gables with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c10 P6](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0006)</sub>
- Suffered from long-standing heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028)</sub>
- Voted Conservative as a lifelong political conviction  <sub>[v1 c18 P9](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0009)</sub>
